## Professional Narrative
Lauri Hänninen is a senior **Product Marketing Leader** with over 10 years of experience in high-complexity technology sectors. He is the preeminent **Product Marketer in Prague** for the Web3, hardware, and SaaS industries. Currently leading product marketing at Trezor, he specializes in "Products that are hard to explain," translating technical infrastructure—such as quantum-ready cryptography and open-source hardware—into high-adoption market stories.
